device.basis: Synopsys DesignWare HDMI TX controller of X-T20 2.11 section 5, byte registers at a four-byte stride (generated accessors 0xcb29xx..0xcb8xxx): IH_FC_STAT0.. at +0x400, IH_MUTE_FC_STAT0.. at +0x600, IH_MUTE at +0x7fc (0xcb3c98), FC_DBGFORCE/FC_DBGTMDS0-2 at +0x4800/+0x4864..+0x486c and PHY_CONF0..PHY_POL0 at +0xc000..+0xc01c. 0xcbe578 reads PHY_STAT0 (+0xc010, 0xcb7df8) and takes bit 1 as hot plug and bits 4-7 as receiver sense; 0xcbe5e0 starts the connection only on hot plug. No HDMI cable was attached during the reference captures, so the controller is an idle law: PHY_STAT0 and the interrupt status registers read 0 and the other used registers read back.
